notes.notes:
We have updated [b]Hate Free Heroes[/b] to 3.0 and added free access to [b]Hate Free Heroes Tactics[/b] for all players. Everyone who purchased or purchases the game will receive free access to [b]Hate Free Heroes Tactics[/b], access to our web browser mobile version and community for [b]Hate Free Heroes[/b] at no extra charge. Logging into the community will allow you to update your place on our leaderboards, update your profile, pictures and more.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/514540/Hate_Free_Heroes_RPG_30/

[h1]To claim Your Free Access[/h1]

If you purchased [b]Hate Free Heroes[/b] from Steam or have the game in your Steam inventory, you qualify to receive free access to our mobile version and [b]Hate Free Heroes Tactics[/b] online game. Simply post in this thread "hfh" and we'll send you your access codes and details. 

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/514540/eventcomments/2963890181158659841]Claim Your Free Access Here[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26545584/3ddd29c67deb5221bcd2abeb08ab478cbd6ed101.png[/img]

[h1]About Hate Free Heroes Tactics[/h1]

Hate Free Heroes Tactics is a community based online game and adventure. Help your city reduce aggro levels by building your agency, defeating aggromites and researching new ways of keeping city aggro levels at a minimum. Play from any web browser, PC, tablet or phone. Build your agency, upgrade your offices with equipment, hire agents to increase your resources, make medical advancements, research new advancements, complete missions, go out on the field and defeat aggromites, engage in cyber defense pvp, upgrade your character gear and so much more. Launch the game from any web browser, no downloads needed.

    Strategy Based Building Game, Turn Based, Character Building RPG
    Fully browser based. Play from any system, phone, tablet or PC
    Community chat, agency and global rankings
    Upgrade your agency base with equipment to earn resources
    Engage in Cyber Defense PVP and build your PVP Rank
    Explore the city and defeat aggromites
    Level up your character (Level Max +120)
    Buy gear and upgrade your character equipment
    Complete research and medical advancements
    Earn in game achievements to earn meta crystals
    Complete Quests and Missions
    Join or create your own agency branch and earn experience
    Compete for ranking and climb the ranks
    Countless hours of gameplay
    and so much more...

notes.title: U Game Me: A word of encouragement
notes.notes:
We would like to thank everyone who supported U Game Me, our development and our games over the years. Although 2020 has been a challenging year for everyone, we are inspired to continue to make strides to provide better opportunities and updates for our games and applications. We are still working hard to do better for everyone who has supported us even now. Thank you for your hope in us and your patience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7334466/b75575a377861306176174f7e853527929777bb9.png[/img]


We are aware of the hardships many people have endured during these trying times from Covid19, the losing of loved ones, job losses, financial difficulties and the confronting of racial inequality. We understand the reality of these challenging times and we extend our encouragement, love and consideration to all of you.

We are working on some new projects and updates and will be keeping you informed on our progress. We’ve updated our website and will be providing news and updates through our monthly newsletters as well.

Be sure to sign up to our monthly newsletter and community for more news and update.

www.ugameme.com

Thank you everyone for your support. Stay safe and be encouraged.

notes.title: King of Crowns Chess Online
notes.notes:
We will be launching King of Crowns Chess Online via Steam on March 27, 2018. Our new chess game has a unique card system that lets you earn in game cards that you can collect and trade in for card points. New look and design, new game boards, chess pieces and more. Some of the game features include:

1.  Earn in game Card Packs and collect Cards to earn Card points.
2. Unique score system to create total score: Mastery Score, Seniority Score, Elo Score and Card Points.
3. Earn Rank Badges and Trophies. Global and Club Ranking System.
4. Select from 4 Clubs levels to join with chat box for each club.
5. Earn Steam Trading Cards.

Remember to join us March 27th and join me personally in an online match.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/576690/King_of_Crowns_Chess_Online/

notes.title: Welcome to 2017... a word from the developer
notes.notes:
2 more of our games have been greenlit thanks to the support of the steam community. As lead developer for all of our games, I would like to extend a sincere thank you to the steam community as a whole for showing your support for our games once again. We owe you all everything as we are a very small team of only 2 people and rely greatly on the support of every player.

We aren't perfect but we are a dedicated and hard working team that has learned a lot since we've gotten our first game on steam. We are working harder than ever to meet your expectations and hope we can continue to make the games you all want to play. We appreciate your support and patience with us as we make strides to bring you the best games at an affordable price. 

We are looking forward to a great year. Making games is what we love to do, and making the games that you want to play is the only reason why we are still doing this. Your support means the world to us, not to sound sentimental but, you are all the reason why we do what we do.

I want to wish all of you a Happy, a Blessed and Prosperous 2017.

Happy New Year!

notes.title: Angels of Fasaria 3.0 Looking Good!
notes.notes:
The new RPG is looking great. It is being done from the ground up so it is a totally new game with so many new features but done in the tradition of the original. The new version of Angels of Fasaria is using the latest version of RPG Maker with lots of cool features and a new look and design.

We are making great progress on the game and will keep the community posted on our progress. If you liked Angels of Fasaria 2.0 you'll love the newest version. We expect to have a release date available early next year. Expect to see it as a stand alone game on steam.

notes.title: 3rd Party Steam Key Time Limit Removed
notes.notes:
After speaking with some players very unpleased about the time limit for 3rd party bundled steam keys, we decided to remove the time limit after all. You all deserve better and I appreciate your support and words of encouragement. You could have gotten angry with us (deservingly) but you kept your cool, contacted us and gave your opinions. 

Business as usual, all keys purchased in the past and future will NOT have a limit on them. The only keys that will have a limit on them are the free access keys for Fasaria World Online which will stop in July.

Please, always reach out to us when there is something you don't like or agree with, we are always open to listen.

notes.title: 3rd Party Steam Key Time Limit Removed
notes.notes:
After speaking with some players very unpleased about the time limit for 3rd party bundled steam keys, we decided to remove the time limit after all. You all deserve better and I appreciate your support and words of encouragement. You could have gotten angry with us (deservingly) but you kept your cool, contacted us and gave your opinions. 

Business as usual, all keys purchased in the past and future will NOT have a limit on them. The only keys that will have a limit on them are the free access keys for Fasaria World Online which will stop in July.

Please, always reach out to us when there is something you don't like or agree with, we are always open to listen.

notes.title: About Bundle Keys and Free Access Keys
notes.notes:
We will be locking all keys that were purchased in bundles from any 3rd party website 1 month after the bundle is over. This should give more than enough time for people who purchased the bundle enough time to activate their game. After that time, we will NOT re-issue any steam keys so make sure you activate your keys within the month you receive the bundle. For those who may have gotten the keys as a gift or sold on a trade website, chances are they will no longer work if the time has expired.

We will be stopping the free access key offer to "Fasaria World Online" for "Angels of Fasaria 2.0" and "AoF World Online" by July 1st. If you have the game and would like to claim your key, now is the time. Once the offer is closed, it won't be available again.

[B]About Hate Free Heroes:[/B]

Hate Free Heroes is a modern day role playing game that takes the player into the role of an H.F.H agent and researcher dedicated to decreasing the rise of "Aggromites" in the city.
 
Aggromites/Aggromite (definition) [ag-roh-myht] [noun]: A mischievous entity that influence a person's aggression levels through the "dream world" or altered reality.
 
Join the H.F.H agency, complete major missions and research missions to help the agency discover the reason behind the growing rise in "Aggro". Journey through the city of Newsport to find faithful agents that will join your cause as you begin to unravel the mystery behind the "Aggromite" influx.

• Explore the Large City of Newsport 
• Major Missions and Research Missions to Complete 
• Upgradeable Gear with Gear Slots 
• Steam Achievements 
• Steam Trading Cards

notes.title: Fasaria World Online FREE with Angels of Fasaria
notes.notes:
We will be providing one access key for Fasaria World Online to everyone who owns a copy of Angels of Fasaria. This access key can be used to unlock one character playable in this multiplayer, rpg, strategy browser based game that is also featured on steam as a stand alone game. This is a $9.99 value that we are giving all players access to at no additional cost. There is nothing players have to do to redeem their key. All accounts will have a CD key assigned to it. This key is what will be used to unlock your access to the browser based game.

Everyone who purchases Angels of Fasaria 2.0 from now on will receive an access key to the game. This is our small way of saying, "thank you" to everyone who have supported Angels of Fasaria thus far. We expect to have the same offer with the upcoming 3.0 version as well. 

Angels of Fasaria mmo alpha test sign ups are still available for those who still hope to see that game become a reality. You can find the sign up thread in the forums.

Expect to see this update with your access key available later this month.

notes.title: February Newsletter: A Lot of Updates Coming!
notes.notes:
We have a lot of major updates on the way for all of our games so keep a look out.

[h1][b]Fasaria World Online:[/b][/h1]

A lot of major changes to the game and a major overhaul of some features are in the works, expect to see a full update to the game very soon.

[h1][b]Angels of Fasaria RPG:[/b][/h1]

We are working on a new version of Angels of Fasaria RPG from the ground up. This new version will be released as a stand alone game and it is TOTALLY different in comparison from the current version. A lot of major changes and improvements will be included to this newer version so it will be sold as a new game. We are still considering creating a browser based mmo to accompany that version but no absolute decision has been made yet.

[h1][b]Angels of Fasaria Online:[/b][/h1]

We still have sign ups open for alpha testing for the online game version of Angels of Fasaria. Not a lot of people have signed up or shown interest so development is currently halted. If you want to see the online game be made, sign up and show your support for it. Currently, you can sign up on steam but private testing may occur which will require an NDA and participation will be outside of steam until the game is ready for beta testing.

[h1][b]AoF Chess Club 2.0:[/b][/h1]

Some nice updates are scheduled for AoF Chess Club 2.0, mainly the translated versions which should open the community to players from around the world. More info soon.

[h1][b]AoF World Online:[/b][/h1]

We have a community edition in the works which will include the server with scripts for all players to be able to launch and play locally on their computer. We will also open up the workshop giving players freedom to edit and submit their modified versions. This should open this game to the community for further development and growth as we are no longer developing this game.

The partner dlc will allow players to host their own server where trial players will have access to play on for free. Active servers will have the opportunity to migrate to our list of servers reserved for paid players.

notes.title: NSE Circuit: December Newsletter
notes.notes:
You can find our full newsletter at NSE Circuit.

http://nsecircuit.com/news/dec15newsletter/

We have a lot of great news to announce for December! First off we would like to wish everyone a Merry Christmas, Happy Holidays and a Happy New Year! We are looking forward to a new a productive year in 2016. Looking back, we've gotten all 4 games greenlit and published on steam in less than 1 year! That is amazing and could only have been accomplished with your continued support. We are going to continue to work hard to meet your demands and your expectations of us, and we are incredibly thrilled and appreciative of your continued support for our games.
 
New NSE Circuit Launcher:
 
We've updated our launcher for Fasaria World Online and AoF Chess Club with a new one that should correct a lot of issues players encountered before, it is also updated with a snazzy look and feel so enjoy and post your input and opinions on the changes.
 
New Website & Shop:
 
We've updated our website with a new design and our community has been updated with better functions and community features for easier navigation. We will also be having monthly give aways and discount coupons exclusive to registered members so look out for those as well.
 
Trial Access & Demos:
 
We will be announcing our trial and demo access for each game in 2016. This should be an interesting way to allow players to experience our games and community while also inviting friends and other players to do the same. More info about our upcoming demos soon.
 
AoF World Online Private Servers:
 
We are considering providing an opportunity for players to host their own private servers while also being able to build their following of players from our community. All players who download the trial version will only have access to play on the private servers but for free. This will make it easy for those who own the private servers to invite players while getting new ones right from our community. If we do decide to do this, we will also offer community opportunities to help private server owners to build their network as well. We will also open up our workshop on steam where developers can modify the server scripts and share it or sell to other players. If this is an idea you support, please vote by posting in our discussion board thread below "I support this idea".
 
http://nsecircuit.com/index.php?page=forum&section=topic&top_id=100218
 
Fasaria World Online New Update:
 
We are working hard on a new expanded version of the game (no cost to current players) that will offer more levels, areas, gear to buy and a lot of other cool features. We have a lot planned for 2016 for updates and community growth. Look for the expanded version later this month.
 
Angels of Fasaria 2.0 Online Game and Future:
 
We are still working on the outline and plans for the online game which will require more time, planning and community building. We want to be sure this game does well when we put it forth in 2017. We are still looking for players who own the game to volunteer for alpha testing which we plan should start early next year. We will be heavily involved with the community and their input for the online game's development. So far we have Angels of Fasaria in the works for a re-make for the RPG and the online game is looking like it will be bundled with the game. Players who sign up and get active in testing will be guaranteed free copies of both. Those who  already have a copy of Angels of Fasaria 2.0 will only have an opportunity to claim a copy of the online game.
 
Please sign up for alpha testing in the thread below:
 
http://nsecircuit.com/index.php?page=forum&section=topic&top_id=100219
 
Showing Your Support for the Community:
 
We will be working hard from now on in building the community and it's involvement. We don't believe showing support is as simple as posting a review or by just receiving public approval as we have seen that such can never genuinely express the heart of it's community. The support will come only with your voice, your input, your ideas and your participation within the community. Such are vital to us as a company and to the future of the community you've helped to build. If you support our company and want to see more come out of our games, join the community on NSE Circuit and contribute your thoughts and ideas and encourage others to do the same. We will be working very closely with our players from now on to build a reliable, cohesive, friendly and active community. With every newsletter from now on, we will open a discussion for your thoughts starting now. Please post your thoughts, opinions, suggestions or ideas concerning this last newsletter in this thread.
 
http://nsecircuit.com/index.php?page=forum&section=topic&top_id=100220

notes.title: NSE Circuit November Newsletter
notes.notes:
Busy, busy, busy. We have a lot going on in November to talk about. Fasaria World Online is expected to release this month on November 5th and Ancients of Fasaria Chess Club on November 4th. Be sure to get the games if you haven't already. We've also just recently added a new web launcher for each game that makes accessing them from steam a snap. Here are some of the updates and changes to look out for.

Fasaria World Online Updates:

1. We have removed the ability to purchase crystals from our online shop and instead replaced it with an "Elite Sponsorship Package" option.

2. ALL players now will receive 50 crystonian crystals every month for free. Crystals have already been added to all accounts this month so log in and spend it!

Ancients of Fasaria Chess Club Updates:

1. We've added the ability to select up to 5 different chess piece styles and 5 different board colors.

2. We added a chat box for each club.

3. We added a match making lobby where you can now organize matches.

Angels of Fasaria 2.0 Updates:

We are still looking for players to volunteer for testing our upcoming mmo for Angels of Fasaria. If you have the game in your inventory, you qualify to join early testing so sign up on the discussion board.

That's all for now. We have a lot of more updates and good news coming soon, so always check in NSE Circuit for all your latest news and updates. 

http://nsecircuit.com

notes.title: Online Game Alpha Testing Sign Up
notes.notes:
Ok, so we're doing it. We are starting the early production of the online game but we need your help if it's going to be any good. We want this game to involve the community's interaction and involvement from the very beginning. We have to first test and make sure the game is stable enough for full production so we want players to test the first area out, give us feedback and suggestions as we continue to build. 

We will be providing alpha testing access for the game to select members. You have to sign up for testing here and be approved. You need to have Angels of Fasaria 2.0 in your game inventory in order to apply. 

This isn't access to a free game! This will only be the first area of the game and changes and updates will continue to evolve the world over time. Please only sign up if you intend to add feedback, suggestions and bug reports.

Testing is estimated to begin in mid November, first come first serve for sign ups. If you want to be added to the testing group, please sign up in the discussion board including the requested info. 

DO NOT SIGN UP HERE! SIGN UP ON THE DISCUSSION BOARD'S OPEN THREAD!

notes.title: Angels of Fasaria: Version 2.0 Release
notes.notes:
After many user suggestions and complaints, we finally decided to do a full update of the RPG game keeping in mind all of the suggestions previously given to us by players. 

Angels of Fasaria is an older title that was supported by it's fans so we didn't want to change the core elements that players seemed to enjoy the most. We decided against doing a re-make of the game and have instead included all of the requested changes in this game so players can enjoy it now. You can play any saved game and the updates will apply to any of your games. It is advised that you start a new game if you want to experience all of the updates in it's entirety.

Version 2.0 Update Log:

1. Mana can now be earned each time you defeat an enemy instead of having to farm them from angels.
2. Enemies now vanish from the field after you defeat them.
3. A combat trainer has been added that will help you out early in the game.
4. Players start out with trainer armor, shield and angel ring (in treasure chest in your room)
5. Maps have been added for all continents. You start out with the first map after speaking with the king. Maps give you an overview of each continent.
6. Crafting cristonia is now easier granting you the ability to craft in bulk.
7. Some price adjustments to armor and weapons to make a little more affordable.
8. Companions now edited so that you only can select one companion per guild.

Discontinuing the Online Game:

We are currently removing the online game version for download and access. The game engine was just too unstable and the players too few to consider this a title worth including as a bundle. 

We are looking into developing a far better, fully stable and supported online game that when completed will be a stand alone title and not bundled. Mostly all of our players play the RPG and never get online. The instability of the mmo just took away from the all around game experience and is more of an annoyance than an asset. If we get a new online version completed, we expect to spend much time building the community and we'll be sure to give all current customers an opportunity to claim a free copy.

We are looking into developing a far better, fully stable and supported online game that when completed will be a stand alone title and not bundled. Mostly all of our players play the RPG and never get online. The instability of the mmo just took away from the all around game experience and is more of an annoyance than an asset. If we get a new online version completed, we expect to spend much time building the community and we'll be sure to give all current customers an opportunity to claim a free copy.

notes.title: New Angels of Fasaria Version
notes.notes:
We've taken a lot of player suggestions to mind and have decided to work on a new version of the RPG portion of Angels of Fasaria. The new game will have major updates and changes, a new battle system and more. The same look and feel and story that players have been familiar with will still be there but fundamental aspects of the game will be updated. No official statement yet if the online version will also receive an overhaul but we'll keep the community posted in the likely hood that it does.

All current players will have access to the new version, it will require no additional fee to obtain and we will have the older version archived to access in the case that you want to complete your precious adventures. Enjoy your current game now and look forward to experiencing the entire adventure once again!

The new edition will be expected to be released Fall of 2016.

Please post your opinions & suggestions in our discussions thread.

notes.notes: The online game has been updated to provide a smother leveling up experience that feels less of a grind. You'll lever up faster at lower levels and more progressively at higher levels. notes.title: If Angels of Fasaria Isn't for You...
notes.notes:
ːaofwingː Angels of Fasaria was once loved by it's supporting players a few years back and it was loved and supported by both the game players and it's community. As we all know, times do change. Although we re-released the game based upon user request, this game might not be for everyone.

[h1]ːaofbladeː If you purchased Angels of Fasaria from steam and are displeased with your purchase in any way, please contact us directly from our website and let us know why you were not satisfied with our game and we will replace your purchase with any of our games now or in the future of equal or more value.[/h1]

ːaofwingː We take to heart every comment and suggestion as our intent is to meet the needs of the players and those who have shown support for our games. All constructive criticism and advice is welcome as we are constantly working hard to do better for our players.

ːaoficeː If you have any concerns or gripes about our game, community, customer service or policies, please let us know in a constructive manner either in private or on the community board. We need to know how to do better for you.

ːaofbowː  We moved on to other projects quite some time ago. The players who supported Angels of Fasaria has contacted us asking for it's return so we posted it on greenlight. From there, it was voted in.

ːaofbowː Angels of Fasaria is here for the people that believe in this type of game but I can understand if it has not lived up to everyone's expectations. If it has not lived up to your expectations, let us know why so we can do better for you, or we can find a way to make it up to you.

ːaoffireː What we can NOT do is allow or support abusive or malicious behavior in anyway. This is not just to protect our community and our company but it isn't fair to those who have or do show support for the game as it robs them of the opportunity to freely engage in the very thing that they do love. That behavior is unfair to the players and it is unsupported.

ːaofmedː We offer customer and free technical support for everyone who purchased the game. If you have any technical issues, feel free to post on steam discussion boards or contact us directly for immediate support and help.

[url=http://my.ancientsoffasaria.com/index.php?page=contact]Contact Us - Technical/Customer Support[/url]

Please feel free to let us know how we can improve on our games and our service. Feel free to comment (observing forum rules). We work hard to make fast replies to all requests and suggestions.
